opening.text: Olivia Parker, your fellow party member, spots you in the hallway and waves you over.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: olivia
segments.text: Hey! I heard you're supporting the Education Reform Bill. That's bold. How's your district reacting?

choices.text: "Mixed reactions, but I think it's the right call."

segments.speaker: olivia
segments.text: She nods understandingly. "I get it. Sometimes you have to vote your conscience even when it's hard. That's why I respect you."

segments.speaker: olivia
segments.text: "Let me know if you need backup on the vote. We're stronger together." She gives you a warm smile before heading to her next meeting.

consequences.high_trust: Olivia will support you on key votes
consequences.low_trust: Olivia may vote differently, weakening your position
